1. Executive Summary & Reviewer-Driven Hardening

TokTickIT Lab 4 extends the enterprise IT Service Desk with full operational task tracking (Actions Taken), strict transition gates (Resolution Gate), database-level concurrency protection (Atomic Optimistic Locking with Predicates), immutable audit trails (Ticket Status History), and role-tailored real-time Dashboards.

Following rigorous code review by @MiMikoChAn913 on Pull Request #55, 5 critical areas (4 × P1, 1 × P2) were hardened with 8 new regression tests:

  • Action Lifecycle & Assignee: Implemented ActionStatus enum (PENDING, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, CANCELLED), operational assignee delegation (assigneeId), inactive-assignee rejection (INACTIVE_ASSIGNEE), terminal action immutability, and conditional result enforcement.
  • Atomic Optimistic Concurrency: Replaced in-memory checks with atomic database write predicates updateMany({ where: { id, version } }) inside transactions, returning HTTP 409 Conflict without silent overwrites.
  • Mandatory Version Validation: Enforced numeric version validation on status writes (HTTP 400 on missing version) and atomic compare-and-increment on tickets.
  • Append-Only Ticket Status History: Added TicketStatusHistory model, writing exactly 1 actor-attributed row in the same transaction as successful status updates, and 0 rows on conflicts.
  • Deterministic E2E Resolution Gate Verification: Eliminated conditional skips, asserting exact rejection on fixture TKT-2026-001233 and resolution success with audit trail on TKT-2026-001234.

[P1] Lifecycle Missing ActionTaken lifecycle, operational assigneeId, inactive-assignee rejection, and premature result requirement. Added ActionStatus enum, assigneeId relation to User, validateAssignee check, terminal immutability, and made result required only on COMPLETED. TEST-ACT-18..20, TEST-ACT-22, TEST-UI-ACT-04..05, E2E-ACT-02 PASS
[P1] Action Lock Non-atomic optimistic concurrency permits silent lost updates under concurrent writes. Implemented atomic database predicate updateMany({ where: { id, version } }) in transaction; returns 409 Conflict if count is 0. TEST-ACT-21 (Concurrent write race condition) PASS
[P1] Ticket Lock Omitting version bypasses ticket concurrency, and update by id permits race conditions. Enforced numeric version validation (400 Bad Request) and atomic compare-and-increment updateMany in database transaction. TEST-WFK-06, TEST-WFK-07 (Stale write & race condition) PASS
[P1] History Status change updates mutable ticket only without append-only TicketStatusHistory. Created TicketStatusHistory table; appended actor-attributed row atomically in same transaction (0 rows appended on conflict). TEST-WFK-08, GET /api/staff/tickets/:id/status-history PASS
[P2] E2E Gate Conditional if (canSelectResolved) allows E2E test to pass without exercising resolution gate. Used deterministic fixtures TKT-2026-001233 (0 actions → rejected) and TKT-2026-001234 (completed → resolved with history). E2E-RES-01, E2E-RES-02 (Deterministic) PASS
